subject: Federal residential clean-energy credit after Public Law 119-21

finding.claim: Public Law 119-21 ended the federal residential clean-energy credit for installations completed after 2025-12-31. A calculation that assumes the credit takes a separately verified legal and tax review.

method: Reading of the cited sources on 2026-09-05, carried into this record on 2026-10-30 from the September 19 note.
